concept: A deep moon-crystal grotto expressing mystery and transformation through strong curled architecture.
floor: One continuous smooth deep-plum slate floor across the full top face, with broad wine-violet shading and no grass, cracks, tiles, symbols, rings, or repeated pattern.
main_structure: One abstract curled moonstone spire at the rear, sweeping upward like a protective spiral beside a broad dark-violet grotto opening without depicting an animal or tail.
rear_props: two broad red-violet star lamps with simple solid faces
side_props: three large dark rounded stones on the upper-left edge
one broad wine-coloured bench and one silver moonstone on the upper-right edge

perimeter.material: one continuous rounded dark-amethyst stone wall with broad silver-grey caps

lighting: soft moonlit violet ambient light with two restrained red-violet lamp pools
must_keep: exact canonical camera, canvas, footprint, stairs, tapered underside, and padding
entire bottom/front half as quiet open plum-slate floor
all additions inside the original silhouette
must_exclude: creature, scorpion, animal, stinger, egg, or familiar baked into the bitmap
zodiac glyph, constellation, text, center circle, platform, plaza, ring, rug, path, or indentation
bridges, clouds, watermark, external shadow, tiny crystals, star specks, cracks, or dense clutter
